Apartment for Rent in Island Park II, Dubai Creek Harbour (The Lagoons)

Provident Estate is proud to present this elegant 1-bedroom apartment in the highly desirable Island Park community at Dubai Creek Harbour. Offering a spacious layout, contemporary finishes, and serene park views, this home is perfect for those seeking comfort, style, and a vibrant lifestyle in one of Dubai’s premier waterfront destinations.

Designed with floor-to-ceiling windows, the apartment is filled with natural light, creating a bright and welcoming atmosphere throughout. The open-plan living and dining area flows seamlessly onto a private balcony overlooking the beautifully landscaped community and park views.

Property Features:

• Spacious 1 Bedroom Apartment
• Bright Open-Plan Living & Dining Area
• Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
• Private Balcony with Park & Community Views
• Contemporary Kitchen with Premium Finishes
• Built-in Wardrobes
• Vacant & Ready to Move In

Community Amenities:

• Swimming Pool
• Fully Equipped Gymnasium
• Landscaped Parks & Green Spaces
• Waterfront Promenade Access
• Family-Friendly Community

Perfectly located in Dubai Creek Harbour, residents enjoy easy access to Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport, retail outlets, cafes, and waterfront attractions.

An ideal home for end-users seeking a premium lifestyle in a peaceful waterfront setting.

Contact us today to arrange a viewing.
